    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it)
    w = next(it)
    cols = [[] for _ in range(w)]
    for i in range(n):
        x = next(it) - 1
        y = next(it)
        cols[x].append((y, i))
    for col in cols:
        col.sort()

    m = min(len(col) for col in cols)
    removal = [0] * m
    rank = [0] * n
    for col in cols:
        for k, (y, i) in enumerate(col):
            rank[i] = k
            if k < m and y > removal[k]:
                removal[k] = y

    q = next(it)
    out = []
    for _ in range(q):
        t = next(it)
        a = next(it) - 1
        k = rank[a]
        out.append("Yes" if k >= m or t < removal[k] else "No")
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
